justification: Both surfaces carry sparse, highly schematic linear marks that can be read as reduced anthropomorphic forms — a stick-like figure with outstretched arms in A, and an upright slab bearing faint low-relief lines that could suggest limbs in B. But A shows a single clearly readable painted figure with additional branching motifs beside it, whereas B shows an architectural setting of upright and fallen blocks whose decoration is barely legible, with no comparable figure, no comparable groupings, and no shared specific motif or relationship.
